mechanism_narrative: A high level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strong labor market conditions that support business expansion and consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high PAYEMS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
